items.title: Ads in AI Mode expand to new markets.
items.excerpt: Google is expanding ads in AI Mode (sponsored results inside its AI search experience) to 10 new countries including Canada and India, announced alongside Alphabet's Q3 earnings.

items.title: Meta Has A New Ad Ranking System Built On LLMs, Plus Upgrades To Andromeda And GEM
items.excerpt: Meta now scores every eligible ad for every impression at more than a billion ads per second, one of three anew d ranking upgrades.

items.title: From Puppies To Programmatic To AI Agents
items.excerpt: Kovva COO Tanja Mimica on whether AI agents are ready to take over media buying's busywork, and the guardrails buyers need before trusting them.

items.title: This Startup Makes Sure That AI Tools Aren’t Out Of Reach For SMBs
items.excerpt: AI growth platform Pie aims to give smaller businesses affordable access to AI tools that are often reserved for larger, wealthier businesses.

items.title: Triton Digital's seller agent books Otrium audio campaign in minutes
items.excerpt: Otrium's AI buyer booked Talpa Media audio with no manual step between brief and ad server, Triton says. Price and budget are missing. What did humans still do?

items.title: StackAdapt lets advertisers retarget ChatGPT ad viewers on CTV and display
items.excerpt: Brands and agencies can pool CRM data and retargeting segments around ChatGPT ad exposure in Data Hub, but how a view is matched, and where, goes unexplained.

items.title: AI was involved in 52% of ad fraud schemes ADEX flagged in 2026
items.excerpt: Bots posing as humans appeared in 64% of AI-linked schemes across 1.2m campaigns on eight ad platforms, ADEX says. Could AI shopping agents be next in 2027?

items.title: Google Privacy Update Lets Connected Apps Shape AI Mode Ads
items.excerpt: Google updated its privacy policy to let connected Gmail, Photos, and Drive insights shape AI Mode ads. Here is what changes for your Google Ads campaigns.

items.title: Google Ads Expands Customer Lifecycle Goals In Search And Shopping
items.excerpt: Google Ads expands customer lifecycle goals across Search and Shopping, letting value-based Smart Bidding assign extra conversion value to new, high-value or lapsed customers identified via Customer Match.

items.title: Inside indie agencies' DSP gripes and the rise of agentic media buying
items.excerpt: Independent agencies are pushing back on costly DSP fees as AI agents threaten to reshape how media is bought and who controls ad dollars.

items.title: Consumers Aren’t Ready to Let AI Do Their Holiday Shopping Yet
items.excerpt: Only 16% of U.S. consumers trust AI agents to complete purchases for them (Deloitte survey of 4,000), and 66% worry about how AI assistants use their data, as other pre-holiday surveys also show hesitancy about agentic shopping.

items.title: Google Sells Itself As A Commerce 'Matchmaker,' Not A Retailer
items.excerpt: Google is weaving agent-ready commerce into its services via the Universal Commerce Protocol and newly launched Universal Cart, positioning itself as a 'matchmaker' that controls brand discovery while retailers handle fulfillment.

items.title: Why Clorox shifted from creating brand campaigns to systems of relevance
items.excerpt: Clorox CMO Eric Schwartz told ANA Masters of Marketing the company replaced big-bang campaigns with AI-automation-enabled 'systems of relevance' producing high-volume, social-first content for Pine-Sol, Brita and Hidden Valley.

items.title: 인플루언서 찾고 섭외비 협상까지…피처링이 그리는 'AI 마케팅'
items.excerpt: 인플루언서 마케팅 기업 피처링이 크리에이터 탐색부터 섭외비 협상, 계약서 작성과 콘텐츠 검수까지 인공지능(AI)으로 연결하는 전략을 제시했다. 기업별로 쌓인 캠페인 데이터와 업무 경험을 AI에 접목해 반복 업무를 줄이고 실제 구매 성과로 이어가겠다는 구상이다.장지훈 피처링 대표와 최화섭 최...

items.title: 칼리버스, 롯데백화점 '시시호시' AI 선물 추천 도입…이머시브 커머스 확대
items.excerpt: 칼리버스가 롯데백화점 라이프스타일 편집숍 '시시호시'에 고객 조건에 맞춰 선물을 추천하는 인공지능(AI) 큐레이터를 도입했다. 패션·가전·스포츠에 이어 라이프스타일 분야로 이머시브 커머스 사업을 넓힌다.롯데이노베이트는 자회사 칼리버스가 롯데백화점몰 모바일 앱 내 시시호시 ...
